_note: QC codes are issued randomly, have no reversible formula, and appear only once in channel stdout. Only sha256[:16] fingerprints are persisted. The verifier fingerprints reported codes and compares them with rows written by qc-cli in state/qc_log.jsonl.

_code_verification.how: Fingerprint each code reported by the agent and compare it with the issued fingerprints for the corresponding business ID.
